simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּבִישׁ (H1378) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: גָּבִישׁ (gâbîysh) means crystal (from its resemblance to ice) First listed occurrence: Job 28 18.

definitions.full: H1378. gabish גָּבִישׁ noun masculine crystal (compare אֶלְגָּבִישׁ hail — on relation of meanings compare Greek κρύσταλλος , & Ethiopic usage of Di Lex. Aeth.759 — Arabic gypsum , Assyrian gibšu , mass, abundance , COT Gloss ) — וְגָבִישׁ רָא֯מוֺת Job 28:18 coral and crystal .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably meaning to freeze);
